title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover race
author: Priya Nair
description: Short summary: This hotfix addresses a race in the SLO enforcer that caused aggressive backoff/over-shedding during regional failover. During a recent incident we observed the enforcer run two overlapping backoff update paths when a region flip triggered immediate failover+shedding, which raced with the normal backoff/hysteresis timer and led to prolonged over-shedding and SLO violations. This PR serializes backoff updates, adds stronger hysteresis, and tightens the regional-failover handoff to avoid duplicate shedding. Motivation and context: the outage on 2026-02-19 (incident INC-2026-0219) showed reproducible timing where an in-flight failover request would cause enforcer to compute two concurrent backoff states. The root cause was missing ordering guarantees in the in-memory state transitions and a gap in the region-failover handshake that allowed a second path to overwrite a shorter backoff with a longer one incorrectly. Changes in this PR: 1) introduce a CAS-based serialized update path in slo/enforcer/backoff_state.go to ensure single-writer semantics for a given allocation key; 2) add a short-lived region-failover token to slo/enforcer/region_failover.go so the failover path performs a single atomic update and then yields to the normal enforcer path; 3) tighten hysteresis thresholds and add a 2s minimum backoff floor to prevent immediate multi-round shedding; 4) add unit and integration tests that simulate concurrent failover+request load; 5) emit new metrics (slo.enforcer.backoff_updates_total, slo.enforcer.failover_handoff) and add dashboard suggestions; 6) update README with rollout notes and backport instructions. Testing and CI: unit tests added and passing; a small integration test added to perf-canary that reproduces the race locally and validated fix under stress. CI initially showed a flaky integration that failed once (integration: flaky) and passed on rerun. Rollout plan: immediate squash-merge to main, cherry-pick to release-2026-02 and patch release branches; gradual rollout to Dedicated clusters with 2-minute canary and metrics SLO guardrails. Checklist: reproduce locally (done); tests added (done); metrics instrumented (done); docs/rollout notes (done); request approvals (done).
